about: A log colour scale's colour-bar ticks: decades (at most six, thinned evenly), labelled with the VALUE, never the exponent. Both legs read this table: frontend/src/components/Stage/mapColorbar.test.ts (canvas) and tests/test_calc_figure_map.py (export). lo/hi are the colour range in data units; no decade sits at an end, where only the canvas prints the range itself.

cases.name: seven decades thin to every other
large values switch to e-notation at 1e3
